line.name: Romeo y Julieta Reserve
line.description: Not on the site. A genuinely distinct line from the site's existing 'Reserva Real' (which is Dominican-made) - Reserve is made in Honduras, confirming a different product rather than a naming variant. Medium-to-full body, a notable departure from RyJ's traditionally milder profile. FLAG: one retailer (Atlantic Cigar) lists the same Churchill vitola under the name 'Romeo y Julieta Habana Reserve Churchill' - likely a retailer naming variant rather than a 4th distinct product, but not confirmed which name Altadis itself uses officially.

vitolas.name: Churchill
vitolas.notes: Matches the Mac photo. Cigar Aficionado has reviewed this vitola across multiple years (2014-2018), confirming an established, recurring SKU.
